document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Plants of every shape and size grow all around you. You fail 
to recognize any as unquestionably prehistoric. You recall how 
long it took to secure funding for this expedition; some physical 
proof might be required to mount another.

To return to Arkham empty-handed, go to 216. To explore further, 
go to 551.
